---
title: "09 | Stillness"
author: "C.O."
date: "September 2026"
draft: false
---

Silence is necessary in certain environments. In order to hear directions, study, or complete a certain task, silence is necessary. Stillness on the other hand is what we experience in nature. The lack of noise in any environment allows us to hear what is being expressed in/to our spirit. Embrace the silence or stillness. May it speak to your soul.

Meditate on these verses to gain wisdom:

-   Week 1
    -   Psalms 46:10
-   Week 2
    -   Mark 4:39
-   Week 3
    -   Psalms 107:29-30
-   Week 4
    -   Psalms 37:7
-   Week 5
    -   1 Timothy 2:2-3
